Variant support under SuSiE-OUT

Source: R/methods.R
susieout_candidate_support.Rd

Lists every tested variant and every omitted variant (OUT state) with its posterior inclusion probability (PIP), sorted from highest to lowest.

Usage

susieout_candidate_support(fit)

Arguments

fit

A susieout_fit object from susieout_fit() or one of the grid-averaged fitting functions.

Value

A data frame with columns variant_id, state ("inside" for tested variants, "outside" for omitted variants), pip, and maximum_component_probability, the largest probability that any single effect assigns to the variant.

Examples

locus <- susieout_simulate_locus(1, architecture = "entirely_omitted")
fit <- susieout_fit(
  locus$z, locus$n, locus$R_analysis, locus$wgs_ld, locus$examined_ids
)
susieout_candidate_support(fit)[1:5, ]
#>     variant_id   state        pip maximum_component_probability
#> v40        v40  inside 0.04196349                   0.004277781
#> v28        v28  inside 0.03861921                   0.003930730
#> v29        v29  inside 0.02933064                   0.002972515
#> v41        v41 outside 0.02656404                   0.002688715
#> v44        v44 outside 0.02528099                   0.002557339
